title: Hadda kallaytat garayte qande
intro: Nabiyyi Macammad dumah yan waktil, Yamanak yemeete cayla le mirac Makkah addal tan diini arac baysoonuh qaskariyyoh gaadu qimbise. ta naqboyti fidin qande miraacisak carbi dakanitte kibbimte, ken maqar kee ixximal kibal luk. faxennal, ken safar gaba kaleh garcik oson qammalsime wayta qibaadah gaba culsa keenit garaye wak. atu baxissam duuddaa miyya foocal kak tanim ta assakat le cisab?
clues: Nanu mango qande kee caylale carbi dakanitte luk diini qari fanah genne
Nanu racmatta le taama abeynit xisse qibaadah arac qanxisnam kee finqisnam niyatne
Qunxa kimmir butta nee fanah ruubeenih, kallayto xaa quukah ken af ​​kee lifiiqa
Nanu xongolot nongoorowem too xaahi amol nee qide, nee korseh raqtam
Anu Yaman baaxok sugeeh, diini arac gorrisak suge miraacah gubat ayfaf ece
Yallih diini arac desafío dirkissa marah ceelallo abne
